# Short Debate Fixture

This directory is reserved for the committed small debate fixture described in
`AGENTS.md`: a trimmed real Riksdagen MP4, captured Riksdagen metadata response,
and official protocol text.

C1 filled `api_response.json` with the current webb-tv Next.js page-data JSON.
C1b filled `official_speeches_response.json` with filtered official
anförandelista entries enriched from each speech's XML detail response, and
`00_source.json` with the C1 source artifact containing those official speeches.
C2 fills the real media-derived fixture artifacts. C0 only creates this
placeholder and the synthetic ffmpeg fixture generator.
